The face in the hall(i think i saw a ghost)
Here's a bit of background to start. I lived with my mom and my sister and my dog at the time. It was the dead of winter so it would be almost pitch black in the morning.

I woke up at 7:00am as I usually did, and got ready for school. I still hadn't turned on any lights as to not wake up my sister and went down stairs. I got to the bottom of the stairs and looked back in to the living room window to make sure no one was there because I was and still am, a paranoid person. No one was there, so I turned back and continued on my way the the kitchen, but as I was turning, I saw a face as pale as snow with black eye sockets and mouth, he looked mad, or unhappy in some way. When I turned back it was got. I ran in to the kitchen in fear, after a good 5mins I got the courage to go back and look to see if it was there. I liked to watch TV while I wait for the time I need to go out to the bus, but as you could imagine, I didn't think about going in front of the stairs to watch some TV. I would not risk that even now.
I once saw a face in the hall of my house. If you want details just look for "face in the hall(I think I saw a ghost)"

A few years back, I was working at this store that I have long forgotten the name of,and I had just started working there and nothing seemed off. But every night this woman would walk home from work, and a few weeks in to the job, two men would walk up to the bench and sit, only a few mins before the woman would walk home from work, since it's late at night I was a bit worried but didn't want to judge. The woman walked right past and the men didn't get up or anything so I felt better. The next night the men came back to the bench, and once again the woman walked right past them and the men didn't move, this continued for the rest of the week. So since this happened for the whole week I was not even thinking about the men or woman. But that night the men seemed off, different, they were more agitated looking and they fidgeted around more than usual. But I had not really paid to it, now this was only a few mins before the woman would walk home from work. The woman finally appeared on the screen and after a few seconds the men got up and went in the same direction that the woman was walking. I looked to the other screens as they went off the screen I can normally see them on and went I find them on a other screen what I saw still has haunt's me to this day. The men were beating up the woman, they were kicking and punching her pretty hard from the looks of it. Then after she stopped squirming, they took her purse. While all that was happening I was calling the gards to see if they could stop the men before they get away while I call the police. But by the time they got there the men were gone. I called the police none the less but the men were never found despite all the footage we had of them. 

(The woman was ok she only had a minor concussion and some bruised ribs, but nothing too serious)
I left the job around a month later due to me not wanting to see that type of thing ever again.
